items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
items.title_zh: 扩展视野而非参数：35B 智能体模型达到万亿参数级性能
items.summary: Agents-A1 is a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model trained with a three-stage recipe — full-domain supervised fine-tuning, domain-level teacher models, and multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment — on long-horizon trajectories averaging 45K tokens. It reports leading results on SEAL-0 (56.4), IFBench (80.6), HiPhO (46.4), FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0) and MolBench-Bind (56.8) against 1T-parameter models such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro, and remains competitive on SciCode, HLE and BrowseComp.

items.title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体规划的自演化世界模型
items.summary: WorldEvolver is a self-evolving world-model framework that revises its deployment-time context while keeping the downstream agent and all model parameters frozen, combining episodic memory for retrieval-based simulation of real transitions, semantic memory for heuristic rules extracted from prediction-observation mismatches, and selective foresight that filters low-confidence predictions. On ALFWorld and ScienceWorld it achieves the highest prediction accuracy across three backbones and leads world-model baselines on downstream agent success rate.

items.title: Contrastive Reflection for Iterative Prompt Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向迭代提示优化的对比反思
items.summary: Contrastive Reflection is an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic information-retrieval workflows that uses structured retrieval or reasoning traces and dimension-level grading rationales to identify error-anchored behavioral slices, adds nearby successful examples, and asks a Teacher LLM for a targeted edit accepted only when validation improves. On a HotpotQA retrieval-augmented QA setup one tree-selected contrastive repair raises held-out exact match from 51.4% to 60.4%, versus 59.4% for MIPROv2 and 57.0% for GEPA.

items.title: Comparing Large Language Models on Scrum Certification-Style Questions: Accuracy, Stability, and Error Patterns
items.title_zh: 比较大型语言模型在 Scrum 认证式问题上的表现：准确率、稳定性与错误模式
items.summary: The study evaluates GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3 Flash and DeepSeek Chat 3.2 on 993 Scrum certification-style questions aligned with the PSM I format under zero-shot, chain-of-thought and source-grounded prompting with repeated executions. Gemini 3 Flash achieved the highest accuracy, followed by GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek Chat 3.2, with low intra-model variability; accuracy was highest on single-answer multiple choice and more error-prone on multi-select and true/false items, and more fragile on topics such as Scrum Values and Self-Managing Teams.

items.title: The Label Imitation Game: Turing Test Network for Zero-Shot Pseudo-Label Pruning
items.title_zh: 标签模仿游戏：用于零样本伪标签剪枝的图灵测试网络
items.summary: The Label Imitation Game formalizes pseudo-label pruning as an adversarial interrogation and trains a Turing Test Network, a task-agnostic judge that evaluates candidate pseudo-labels within dataset-wide context. Across four datasets it improves label accuracy for three vision-language models without extra supervision or retraining, yields F1 gains of 28% for the worst baseline categories and 44% with task-specific fine-tuning, and enables zero-shot transfer from classification to object-detection pruning.

items.title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
items.title_zh: AgRefactor：面向 HLS 兼容性与性能的自演化智能体工作流
items.summary: AgRefactor is an LLM-based multi-agent workflow that refactors software into HLS-compatible programs, with a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks and automated refactoring tools that balance LLM rewrites with tool transformations. On 9 of 11 real-world benchmarks 5–10x longer than prior cases it matches or beats the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM baseline, and further optimization yields a 6.51x geometric-mean speedup over a pragma-tuning tool.

items.title: HORIZON: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
items.title_zh: HORIZON：将硬件设计视为仓库级代码演化的智能体框架
items.summary: HORIZON is a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution, compiling a Markdown harness into a project pack containing domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate and a git/runtime policy. items.title: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw
items.title_zh: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw — 基于AI Agent + MCP的自动化渗透测试框架
items.summary: VulnClaw is an AI-agent, MCP-toolchain and penetration-skill orchestration framework that automates the full pipeline from information gathering through vulnerability discovery and exploitation to report generation using natural-language input.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.title_zh: xbtlin/ai-berkshire — AI时代的伯克希尔：基于多Agent的价值投资研究框架
items.summary: AI-era Berkshire is a value-investing research framework built for Claude Code and Codex that implements the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping and Li Lu through multi-agent adversarial analysis.

items.title: BAAI/bge-m3
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 北京智源多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BGE-M3 from the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence is a multilingual embedding model built on XLM-RoBERTa with over 31 million downloads, widely used for retrieval and feature extraction.
